title: API-only plans, no migration code
decision: No migration or v2-awareness in code; plans are read and written only through plan.py; no code parses plan Markdown. Migration of old plans is manual by packages/task/docs/migration/v2-to-v3.md. D4 point 1 (a v2 stop line in the commands) is superseded; the rest of D4 stands.
rationale: Owner message 2026-10-05: no migration in code, old plans do not exist for the engine, migration is manual by instruction.
